SELECT BusinessDay as CurrBusDate, 
  RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), BusinessDay,101),4) + LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), BusinessDay,101),2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), BusinessDay,101),4,2) AS CurrBusDayInt,
  PrevBussDay as PrevBusDate, 
  RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), PrevBussDay,101),4) + LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), PrevBussDay,101),2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), PrevBussDay,101),4,2) AS PrevBusDayInt,
 isholiday,  
  CASE WHEN WeekEnd IS NOT NULL AND isHoliday = 1 THEN 'NOPASS' ELSE 'PASS' END AS HolidayPass
 FROM Utility.dbo.Calendar 
 WHERE CAST(CurrentDate as Date)  = Cast(getDate() as Date)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Change_Sts
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Create_Sts
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Out_Status_Stp
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

DECLARE  @BusinessDay  as Date;
SET @BusinessDay = (SELECT BusinessDay as CurrBusDate  FROM Utility.dbo.Calendar 
WHERE CAST(CurrentDate as Date)  = Cast(getDate() as Date));
--SET @BusinessDay = '2020-11-30'
--*****************************************(For non stp trades get the latest status records)
--Get Trade Details from CIRC Live Trade
SELECT [Trade Id] as Trade_ID, 
Book, 
TradeStatus, 
[Book Id] as Book_ID,  
rtrim(cast(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), modified_date, 101) + REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), modified_date, 109), 12 , 128),':000', ' ') as varchar(25) ) ) as modified_date_key, 
CONVERT(nvarchar(128), modified_date, 101) + REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), modified_date, 109), 12 , 128),':000', ' ')  as modDate
INTO #tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade
FROM dbo.tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade
--Get Outlier Status
SELECT LT.modified_date_key AS modified_date, 
@BusinessDay AS Business_Date, 
LT.Trade_ID, 
LT.TradeStatus, 
OT.Ownership, 
LT.Book, 
IM.TRADING_UNIT_NAME, 
IM.DESK_NAME
INTO #tbl_OutlierStatus
FROM (#tbl_CIRC_LiveTrade LT
INNER JOIN dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Out_TradeStatus OT ON LT.TradeStatus = OT.outTradeSts) 
--INNER JOIN dbo.vw_RTS_InvMap_TradingUnit IM ON LT.Book = IM.Book_Name;
INNER JOIN (
 SELECT DISTINCT a.TRADING_UNIT_NAME, a.DESK_NAME, a.INVENTORY_NAME as book_Name,
		Case when charindex('London', [DESK_NAME], 1)> 0 then 'London'
		 when charindex('Kong', [DESK_NAME], 1)> 0 then 'Hong Kong'
		 else 'US' end as Region
		FROM dbo.tbl_IM_GENERIC_ALLSTATUS a
		WHERE a.STATUS = 'Active'
		and [system_of_record] = 'Calypso'
		and [DESK_NAME] not in
		(
			'Short End- Agencies',   
			'NOT WFS',   
			'TBD - Do Not Use', 
			'Modelling & Analysis - Not Live',
			'ND Rates - Long End',
			'ND Rates - Short End',
			'ND Rates - Swaps'
		)
		and [TRADING_UNIT_NAME] in (
		'Liquid Products - Swaps',
		'Short End Trading',
		'Liquid Products - Muni Derivatives',
		'Liquid Products - Options',
		'Rates Trading',
		'Investment Portfolio Hedging',
		'NonDollar Rates Trading',
		'Reinvestment and Structured Funding Trading',
		'Municipal Derivatives Trading',
		'Liquid Products - International',
		'Global Swaps',
		'Rates Vol'
		)) IM ON LT.Book = IM.Book_Name;

--*****************************************(For non stp trades add audit table detail to the latest status records)
--Get the BOA Trade Change Status details 
INSERT INTO tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Trade_Change_Status
(loadDate,
modifiedDate, 
businessDate, 
ownership, 
tradeID, 
tradeStatus, 
modifDate, 
entityFieldName, 
oldValue, 
newValue, 
auditAction, 
book, 
tradingUnitName, 
deskName )
SELECT TC.loadDate,
OS.Modified_Date, 
OS.Business_Date, 
OS.Ownership, 
OS.Trade_ID, 
OS.TradeStatus, 
TC.modifDate, 
TC.entityFieldName, 
TC.oldValue, 
TC.newValue, 
TC.auditAction, 
OS.Book, 
OS.TRADING_UNIT_NAME, 
OS.DESK_NAME
FROM (#tbl_OutlierStatus OS 
LEFT JOIN dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Change_Sts TC ON OS.Trade_ID = TC.entityId) 
LEFT JOIN dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Create_Sts TK ON OS.Trade_ID = TK.entityId
WHERE 0 = 
CASE WHEN ISNULL(TC.modifDate, '') = '' AND ISNULL(TK.enteredDate,'') = '' THEN 0	
WHEN ISNULL(TC.modifDate, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(TK.enteredDate,'') <> '' THEN 0	
WHEN ISNULL(TC.modifDate, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(TK.enteredDate,'') = '' THEN 0
ELSE 1
END
ORDER BY OS.Trade_ID, TC.modifDate;
--*****************************************(For stp trades add audit table detail to the latest status records)
--Get the Outstanding STP BOA CHANGES details
INSERT INTO tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Out_Stp_BOA_Changes
(loadDate,
entityId, 
tradeStatus, 
modifDate, 
oldValue, 
newValue, 
auditAction, 
bookName, 
clearingChannel,
ecnSource,
tradingUnitName, 
deskName )
SELECT TC.loadDate,
TC.entityId, 
ST.tradeStatus, 
TC.modifDate, 
TC.oldValue,
TC.newValue,
TC.auditAction,
ST.bookName,
ST.clearingChannel,
ST.ecnSource,
IM.TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
IM.DESK_NAME
FROM (dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Change_Sts TC --audit data table
INNER JOIN dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Out_Status_Stp ST ON TC.entityId = ST.tradeId) --current stp trades table
INNER JOIN dbo.vw_RTS_InvMap_TradingUnit IM ON ST.bookName = IM.Book_Name;
--Get the Outstanding Status Diff Business day
SELECT TC.modifiedDate, 
TC.businessDate, 
TC.ownership, 
TC.tradeId, 
TC.tradeStatus, 
Max(TC.modifDate) AS Latest_Mod_Date
--Max(Format(TC.modifDate,'mm/dd/yy')) AS latestDate
INTO #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd
FROM dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Trade_Change_Status TC
GROUP BY TC.modifiedDate, TC.businessDate, TC.ownership, TC.tradeId, TC.tradeStatus
HAVING Max(TC.modifDate) Is Not Null;
--*****************************************  STP trade aging applied here
--Update the Calendar Business day in the non-stp main table
UPDATE TC
SET calBusDayDiff =  AL.calBusDayDiff
FROM dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Trade_Change_Status TC
INNER JOIN
(SELECT (Count(CL.CurrentDate) - 1) AS calBusDayDiff, OL.tradeId, OL.businessDate
FROM Utility.dbo.Calendar CL
INNER JOIN #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd OL ON CAST(CL.currentDate as Date) between CAST(OL.Latest_Mod_Date as Date) and CAST(OL.businessDate as Date)
WHERE CL.Isholiday = 0 
GROUP BY OL.tradeId, OL.businessDate) as AL
ON TC.businessDate = AL.businessDate
AND TC.tradeId = AL.tradeId
--*****************************************(NON-stp trades with updated statuses are added to report table)
--Get the Outlier Latest Update 2 - Non STP
SELECT 	modifiedDate, 
book, 
businessDate, 
ownership, 
tradeId, 
TradeStatus, 
Max(modifDate) AS Latest_Mod_Date, 
Avg(calBusDayDiff) AS DateDifference, 
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
INTO #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2
FROM dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_BOA_Trade_Change_Status
GROUP BY modifiedDate, Book, businessDate, Ownership, tradeId, TradeStatus, tradingUnitName, deskName;
--Get the Outstanding Status - Non STP
INSERT INTO [tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Outstanding_Status]
(
modifiedDate, 
bookName,
ownership, 
tradeId, 
tradeStatus, 
latestModDate, 
dateDif,
[1D],
[2D],
[3D],
[5D],
[10D],
[10DD],
ratesMOBooks,
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
)
SELECT 
modifiedDate, 
book,
ownership, 
tradeId, 
TradeStatus, 
Latest_Mod_Date, 
CASE 
WHEN Latest_Mod_Date IS NULL THEN 11 ELSE DateDifference
END AS dateDif,
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference < 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [1D],
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference >= 1) AND (DateDifference < 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [2D],
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference >= 2) AND (DateDifference < 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [3D],
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference >= 3) AND (DateDifference < 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [5D],
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference >= 5) AND (DateDifference < 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [10D],
CASE 
WHEN (DateDifference >= 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [10DD],
'Y',
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
FROM #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2
--*****************************************(stp trades with updated statuses are added to report table)
--Get the Outlier Latest Update 2 - STP
SELECT 	entityId AS tradeId, 
TradeStatus, 
oldValue,
newValue,
auditAction,
Max(modifDate) AS Latest_Mod_Date, 
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
INTO #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2_STP_Step1
FROM dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Out_Stp_BOA_Changes
GROUP BY entityId, tradeStatus, oldValue, newValue, auditAction, tradingUnitName, deskName;
--*****************************************  STP trade aging applied here
SELECT 	tradeId, 
TradeStatus, 
oldValue,
newValue,
auditAction,
Latest_Mod_Date, 
tradingUnitName, 
deskName,
CASE 
WHEN Latest_Mod_Date IS NULL THEN 11 
ELSE DateDiff(d,[Latest_Mod_Date],GETDATE())
END AS dateDifference
INTO #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2_STP
FROM #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2_STP_Step1
--Get the Outstanding Status - STP
INSERT INTO [tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Outstanding_Status]
(
modifiedDate, 
ownership, 
tradeId, 
tradeStatus, 
latestModDate, 
dateDif,
[1D],
[2D],
[3D],
[5D],
[10D],
[10DD],
ratesMOBooks,
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
)
SELECT 
GETDATE(), 
'STP', 
tradeId, 
TradeStatus, 
MAX(Latest_Mod_Date) AS Latest_Mod_Date, 
dateDifference AS dateDif,
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference < 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [1D],
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference >= 1) AND (dateDifference < 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [2D],
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference >= 2) AND (dateDifference < 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [3D],
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference >= 3) AND (dateDifference < 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [5D],
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference >= 5) AND (dateDifference < 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [10D],
CASE 
WHEN (dateDifference >= 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS [10DD],
'Y',
tradingUnitName, 
deskName
FROM #tbl_Outlier_Latest_Upd_2_STP
GROUP BY tradeId, TradeStatus, dateDifference, tradingUnitName, deskName
--Update Business day where is it Null
UPDATE OS
SET OS.businessDate = @BusinessDay
FROM dbo.tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Outstanding_Status OS
WHERE OS.businessDate is NULL
--Insert one row with zeroes in all aging buckets when there are no records

(
modifiedDate,
tradeId,  
businessDate,
[1D],
[2D],
[3D],
[5D],
[10D],
[10DD],
ratesMOBooks

SELECT @BusinessDay, 
'NULL',
@BusinessDay, 
'0',
'0',
'0',
'0',
'0',
'0',
'Y'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.[tbl_Calypso_Trade_Status_Monitor_Outstanding_Status])

sSourceTradeOutstandingStatusSTPQuery.defaultValue:
select trade.trade_id, trade_status, product_type, book_name, book.book_id, ClearingChannel, ECN_SOURCE
from CALYPSODBA.Trade trade
inner join cALYPSODBA.PRODUCT_DESC prod
on prod.product_id = trade.product_id
inner join CALYPSODBA.BOOK book
on book.book_id = trade.book_id
inner join
(
SELECT tk.trade_id, tk.keyword_value as ClearingChannel
from calypsodba.trade_keyword tk
where upper(tk.keyword_name) = 'CLEARING_CHANNEL' and upper(tk.keyword_value) = 'MARKITWIRE') CLEARINGCHAN_KW
on CLEARINGCHAN_KW.trade_id = trade.trade_id
inner join
(
SELECT tk1.trade_id, tk1.keyword_value as ECN_SOURCE
from calypsodba.trade_keyword tk1
where upper(tk1.keyword_name) = 'ECN_SOURCE' and upper(tk1.keyword_value) = 'STPHUB') ECNSOURCE_KW
on ECNSOURCE_KW.trade_id = trade.trade_id
where trade_status in ('VERIFIED', 'DAY_VER_STP')

sSourceBOATradeChangeStatusQuery.defaultValue:
SELECT ENTITY_ID, ENTITY_FIELD_NAME, OLD_VALUE, NEW_VALUE, AUDIT_ACTION, Modif_Date
FROM CALYPSODBA.BO_AUDIT
where MODIF_DATE between TRUNC(SYSDATE)-11 and TRUNC(SYSDATE) and Entity_Field_name in ('_status')
order by entity_id, modif_date

sSourceBOATradeCreateStatusQuery.defaultValue:
SELECT ENTITY_ID, AUDIT_ACTION as Entered_TRADE, Modif_Date as entered_Date
FROM CALYPSODBA.BO_AUDIT
where MODIF_DATE between TRUNC(SYSDATE)-3 and TRUNC(SYSDATE) and Entity_Field_name in ('CREATE')
and audit_Action = 'NEW'
order by entity_id, modif_date
